translation: copyright holder is required: please configure 'git config user.name' or specify --holder
All tracked files already have valid license headers and formatting.
Applied license headers or fixes to {{.Count}} files.

Usage: license_enforcer [options] [filenames...]

Options:
  --holder string               Copyright holder (default: git config user.name)
  --license string              SPDX license identifier (default: from root LICENSE, or "Apache-2.0")
  --acceptable-licenses string  List of acceptable SPDX license identifiers (comma/space-separated)
  --exclude string              Space-separated list of paths to exclude
  --filter string               Regex to filter files
